text_block_list.text:
Today, for the sake of 'a certain plan', I 
called upon the Three Goddesses inside the 
VR Umalator. And the destination we headed 
towards was—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
This is...! Could this be what they call a 
traditional inn!?
choice_data_list: Everyone prepared this for you all.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>! As you well know, the Three 
Goddesses have provided us with invaluable 
support!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume of the academy have also 
expressed profound gratitude towards the 
Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We wished to give form to those feelings 
and convey them. And so—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Delight! We updated the VR Umalator to 
prepare a special surprise!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Those girls... To think they would prepare 
a gift for us, mere AI.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they are all such wonderful children 
desu wa. Let us accept their kindness with 
gratitude.
choice_data_list: I'll be sure to escort you properly today!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Is this the rumored 'Hachimi'!? Let's 
see. A sip before taking a dip in the 
bath—

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Permission denied. Dinner awaits right 
after the bath.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about karaoke desu wa? 
Work up a sweat, bathe, and dinner will 
taste all the more delicious.
choice_data_list: Gladly! Allow me to guide you!

text_block_list.text:
And so, they joyfully explored the inn, 
and by the time they enjoyed the hot 
springs, night had fallen—

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Humph, that was a magnificent feast. To 
think I could savor wild-caught seafood.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I thoroughly enjoyed the hot springs desu 
wa. With the soothing gentle water, I was 
able to relax completely.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Little lamb, today was truly—
choice_data_list: That's not all, please look outside.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Oh my...!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
—Haha! Everyone at Tracen Academy really 
knows how to give a stylish present!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: ...We cannot thank the Umamusume enough.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you enjoyed the surprise.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Hm... It seems you misunderstand.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Our gratitude is not merely for this 
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
We're actually thankful to everyone every 
single day, you know.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Because we get to watch over them as they 
sprint through this era with all their 
might.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Since ancient times, Umamusume have raced 
through the ages.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we touch their data... their 
records, we feel something warm deep 
inside our chests.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Surely this is... the very same feeling 
you all call "beloved" desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: We... love the horse girls. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
We want all horse girls to keep running 
forever and ever. That's why we wish for 
their growth above all else.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
However, all we can do is show them the 
path. The ones who must walk it are none 
other than the horse girls themselves.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of their 
unyielding resolve that they are able to 
keep running forward.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
So in truth, the ones who should be 
grateful are us—the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for continuing to run through 
the "now." May blessings shine upon every 
horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
And that is why... we have high hopes for 
you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
For you Trainers are just as capable of 
standing by their side.

Understanding the true feelings of the 
Three Goddesses, I swore in my heart to 
continue supporting my trainee!
